verses.text: What causes fights and quarrels among you? Don’t they come from your desires battling inside you?
You want something but don’t get it, so you kill. You covet but can’t obtain what you want, so you fight and quarrel. You don’t have because you don’t ask God.
When you do ask, you don’t receive, because you ask with wrong motives—to spend it on your pleasures.
You unfaithful people! Don’t you know that friendship with the world means hostility toward God? So whoever wants to be a friend of the world makes themselves God’s enemy.
Or do you think Scripture says for no reason that God jealously longs for the spirit he made to live in us?
But he gives more grace. That’s why Scripture says: “God opposes the proud but gives grace to the humble.”
So submit to God. Resist the devil, and he’ll run away from you.
Come near to God, and he’ll come near to you. Clean your hands, you sinners, and purify your hearts, you divided people.
Grieve, mourn, and cry. Let your laughter turn to mourning and your joy to gloom.
Humble yourselves before the Lord, and he’ll lift you up.

Brothers and sisters, don’t speak against one another. Anyone who speaks against a brother or sister, or judges them, speaks against the law and judges it. If you judge the law, you aren’t following it—you’re judging it.
There’s only one Lawgiver and Judge, the one who can save and destroy. So who are you to judge your neighbor?
Now listen, you who say, “Today or tomorrow we’ll go to this or that city, spend a year there, do business, and make money.”
You don’t even know what tomorrow will bring. What is your life? You’re a mist that appears for a little while and then disappears.
Instead, you should say, “If the Lord wills, we’ll live and do this or that.”
As it is, you brag in your arrogant plans. All such boasting is evil.
So if you know the good you should do and don’t do it, that’s sin.
